title: CURVE: A Benchmark for Cultural and Multilingual Long Video Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on a long-video question-answering benchmark featuring authentic cultural events from 18 diverse global locales, and using Iterative Error Isolation on evidence graphs to trace reasoning failures specifically to cultural visual perception.

Comparing model performance on video reasoning tasks across 18 native languages, ranging from high-resource (e.g., English) to low-resource (e.g., Tamil, Telugu), and conducting cross-lingual consistency experiments by evaluating models on translated queries.
